title: Codex review findings ledger
description: Orchestrator-owned record of every finding fingerprint across fix-loop rounds. Codex never writes this file; it is supplied to Codex as read-only context during verification and circuit-breaker escalation.

ledger_version.description: Schema revision of this ledger document, for example 1.

current_round.description: Round 1 is the fresh complete review. Each verification pass increments it.

baseline_ref.description: Target baseline every entry was classified against.

fingerprint.description: Stable key. Never renumbered between rounds; renumbering breaks breaker accounting.

status.description: open: unaddressed. fixed: an executor claims repair, unverified. verified: a review pass confirmed the invariant holds. reopened: a later pass produced new evidence that the invariant still breaks. accepted: closed with a concrete rationale. backlogged: deferred with a link.

root_cause_family.description: Shared key across fingerprints tracing to one root defect. Two or more entries sharing this key is a circuit-breaker trigger.

fix_attempts.description: Count of completed repair attempts against this fingerprint. Reaching 2 while status is not verified trips the circuit breaker.

clarifications_used.description: At most one clarification per finding family. A second request for the same family escalates instead.

blocking.description: True only when the finding is Critical or High with evidence class EMPIRICALLY_VERIFIED or PROBED and scope status REGRESSION or NEWLY_REACHABLE, or when user or project policy requires it to block.

blocking_reason.description: Required in practice when blocking is true and the entry is PRE_EXISTING: name the policy or ticket scope that makes it block.

disposition_rationale.description: Concrete reason for accepted or backlogged. Never a restatement of the finding.

architect_runs.description: One repair architect per finding family. A second escalation for the same family means stop and replan.
